issues.summary: The DW-26 known-limitation pin relied on validator message prose ('at least 1') and an exact raw-JSON substring ('"StartColumn": 0'), which can spuriously fail after a harmless validator message or manifest-formatting change.
issues.fix: Keep IsValid==false; assert StartColumn==0 by structurally walking the parsed manifest (HasZeroStartColumn), and key the error match on the schema PATH + keyword ('StartColumn' + '[minimum]') instead of the human message.
issues.resolutionNote: Added HasZeroStartColumn(JsonElement) structural walk; changed error match to require '[minimum]' (the keyword) + 'StartColumn' (the InstanceLocation), dropping the 'at least 1' prose and the exact-substring scan.

issues.summary: Several ribbon assertions pinned exact corpus-specific names/ids ('Help', 'tab1', 'modRibbonCallbacks') while the test was described as asserting corpus-independent invariants.
issues.fix: Split capability-level invariants (custom ribbon present with >=1 tab; OnLoad/OnAction entry points surfaced and Resolved with a non-empty module) from corpus-specific canaries (exact names), and label the canaries explicitly.
issues.resolutionNote: Added capability-level assertions (NotEmpty Tabs; Resolved + non-empty ModuleName on onLoad/onActions) and relabeled the exact 'Help'/'tab1'/'modRibbonCallbacks' checks as CORPUS-SPECIFIC CANARIES in both the inline comments and the class header.
